definitions.full: H5289. naar II. נַ֫עַר 239 noun masculine 1 boy, lad, youth . 2 retainer (not in P) (Late Hebrew as Biblical Hebrew; Phoenician נער Lzb 324 ); — ׳נ absolute Gen 37:2 +; construct 1Sam 2:13 +; suffix נַעֲרוֺ Judg 19:3 +, נַעֲרָהּ 2Kin 4:24 ; plural נְעָרִים 1Sam 25:5 +, construct נַעֲרֵי Exod 24:5 +; suffix נְעָרַי Neh 4:10 ; 5:10 , etc.; — 1 boy, lad, youth (c. 133 t.) a. of infant Exod 2:6 (E; 3 months old), to be born Judg 13:5 , 7 , 8 , 12 , just born 1Sam 4:21 , not weaned 1:22 ; also Isa 8:4 , compare 7:16 +. b. of lad just weaned 1Sam 1:24 (strike out 2nd נער , compare further Dr Bu HPS), 1:25 ; 1:27 , etc. c. = youth: of young Ishmael Gen 21:12 f. (E), Isaac 22:5 , 12 (E), Joseph 37:2 (E; 17 years old), Benjamin 43:8 ; 44:22 f. (J), sons of Samuel 1Sam 2:17 , of Jesse 16:11 ; ׳נ קָטֹן little lad 20:35 ; 1Kin 3:7 ; 2Kin 5:14 ; Isa 11:6 , ׳נ קָטָן 1Kin 11:17 , plural 2Kin 2:23 . d. ׳נ with special stress on youthfulness Judg 8:20 ; 1Sam 17:33 , 42 ; Hosea 11:1 ; Isa 3:4 compare Eccl 10:16 ; Isa 3:5 ; 10:19 ; Jer 1:6-7 , 1Chr 22:5 ; 29:1 ; 2Chr 13:7 ; 34:3 ; so in phrase ׳מִנּ זָקֵן וְעַד Gen 19:4 (J), Josh 6:21 (J), Est 3:13 compare Exod 10:9 (E), Deut 28:50 ; Isa 20:4 ; 65:20 ; Jer 51:22 ; Lam 2:21 ; Psa 37:25 ; 148:12 ; Prov 22:6 . e. of marriageable age Gen 34:19 (J), warrior Absalom 2Sam 18:5 , 12 +, Zadok 1Chr 12:28 , etc. 2 servant, retainer (c. 105 t): a. = personal attendant, household servant, Num 22:22 (J), Judg 7:10 ; 7:11 ; 19:3 ; 1Sam 9:3 f.; 2Kin 4:12 ; 4:25 +? b. = retainer, follower Gen 14:24 ; 1Sam 25:5 f.; 2Sam 2:14 f.; 1Kin 20:14 f.; 2Kin 19:6 = Isa 37:6 ; Job 1:15-16 , 17 ; Neh 4:10 ; 4:17 +? Zech 11:16 is corrupt, compare We Now. — Note. נער occurs in Pentateuch as Kt with Qr perpet. נַעֲרָה q. v.
